about.label: ABOUT ME
about.headline: BIOGRAPHY
about.bio_intro: Hello! I am **Thanakhon Oonklan**, nicknamed **“JJ”**, a developer constantly honing my skills toward becoming a **Full Stack Developer**. I possess a solid foundation and particular interest in Frontend Development, UI/UX Design, and Web Application Development, with hands-on experience building real-world projects using technologies such as Next.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript. Currently, I am expanding my knowledge in **Backend Development** to develop comprehensive capabilities across both frontend and backend. Furthermore, I have a strong interest in IoT and Robotics, enabling me to bridge the gap between software and hardware and apply multidisciplinary knowledge to engineering projects. I graduated with a Bachelor's Degree from **King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus)** in **Bachelor of Industrial Technology (Industrial Technology and Management)**.
about.bio_edu_desc: King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus), Bachelor of Industrial Technology Program in Industrial Technology and Management.
about.bio_exp_desc: Former Robotics Engineering Intern at Wireless Solution Asia and freelance Software Engineer.
about.bio_rec_desc: 2nd Place Award in National Contest of the New Generation (ESP32 Robot Controller).
